summary: Participants discussed alternatives such as reducing coverage, shifting workload to committers, increasing budget, speeding up builds, and implementing a custom merge queue. The proposal introduces an on-demand lookup join that streams data can use to retrieve matching records from external storage, avoiding full static side loads. Hyukjin Kwon is running a trial of an AI code review bot for new Apache Spark pull requests, using Claude to analyze diffs and post inline comments without approving or LGTM. The bot triggers on new commits, respects open review comments, and can be disabled per PR via an `ai-review-requested` label, with safeguards against excessive Jira API calls.
